## Description {#details}

<p>Represents a Def-use/Use-def edge in SandboxIR.</p>


<p>NOTE: Unlike <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/use">llvm::Use</a>, this is not an integral part of the use-def chains. It is also not uniqued and is currently passed by value, so you can have more than one <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sandboxir/use">sandboxir::Use</a> objects for the same use-def edge.</p>


<p>Definition at line 32 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/sandboxir/use-h">Use.h</a>.</p>
